question: GQ-007
subject: telling a duplicate edition from a quotation, by measurement
the_open_item: 11 duplicate-edition candidates were reported with no guidance on which volume to prefer

my_first_threshold_was_a_guess.result: every KNOWN duplicate read as "quotation" — Selborne at 0.18, Medical logic at 0.28
my_first_threshold_was_a_guess.why_overlap_fails: two scans of one book share only 0.18-0.34 of their exact passages, because OCR differences break exact matching

the_signal_that_works.the_quotation_pair: 0.60 — a 746-passage journal quoted inside a 1,238-passage voyage narrative
the_signal_that_works.threshold: 0.85, derived from these eleven pairs rather than chosen

result.and: each same-work pair now names the fuller scan, so a curation decision has a recommendation behind it

not_deleted: still reported, not removed — which edition a library keeps remains a curation decision

a_scaling_limit_the_pipeline_caught.symptom: the rebuild stopped at step 1 with "migration failed"
a_scaling_limit_the_pipeline_caught.cause: E2BIG — 1,128 insert statements passed as a single argv exceeded the OS argument limit
a_scaling_limit_the_pipeline_caught.the_same_defect_as: add-longs-variants at 2,000 rows, fixed weeks-equivalent earlier this session by piping SQL on stdin
a_scaling_limit_the_pipeline_caught.fix: migrate-book-external now pipes SQL on stdin too
a_scaling_limit_the_pipeline_caught.the_guard_worked: the pipeline refused to continue to the index step rather than building on a failed migration

a_book_that_legitimately_indexes_to_noth.builder_behaviour: logged "NO PARAGRAPHS — skipped" and indexed nothing, which is correct
a_book_that_legitimately_indexes_to_noth.what_it_broke: BOTH completeness guards read the one-book gap as a truncated index
a_book_that_legitimately_indexes_to_noth.fix: the builder records skipped_no_paragraphs in corpus_stats; both guards subtract it
a_book_that_legitimately_indexes_to_noth.now: "complete: 1127 indexed + 1 skipped (OCR noise) accounts for 1128 texts"
a_book_that_legitimately_indexes_to_noth.why_not_just_widen_the_tolerance: a guard that tolerates ANY gap stops detecting a truncated index — the skip count makes the exception exact

a_masking_bug_i_caught_while_adding_the_.what: I piped the builder through tee to capture its log
a_masking_bug_i_caught_while_adding_the_.problem: "cmd | tee" returns TEE exit status, so a FAILED index build would have passed silently
a_masking_bug_i_caught_while_adding_the_.same_shape_as: || true swallowing a gate in the verify chain
